en.summary: A former Rajasthan minister received a show-cause notice following his announcement of leaving the Congress party.

stories.title: Aradhana Misra Mona appointed as new chief of Uttar Pradesh Congress

en.title: Aradhana Misra Mona appointed as new chief of Uttar Pradesh Congress
en.summary: Aradhana Misra Mona was appointed as the new chief of Uttar Pradesh Congress, with Imran Masood as Working President. The appointments are viewed as efforts to build a coalition ahead of assembly elections.

stories.title: 'Will Strengthen Alliance With Samajwadi Party': New UP Congress Chief Aradhana Misra

en.title: 'Will Strengthen Alliance With Samajwadi Party': New UP Congress Chief Aradhana Misra
en.summary: The new Uttar Pradesh Congress chief Aradhana Misra committed to strengthening an alliance with the Samajwadi Party and will lead seat-sharing negotiations for upcoming assembly elections.

stories.title: Protests held across country demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s ouster, hundreds detained

en.title: Protests held across country demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's ouster, hundreds detained
en.summary: Nationwide protests demanding the Chief Election Commissioner's removal took place, with hundreds detained. Congress leader Rahul Gandhi criticized police actions, while various parties and activists called for electoral reforms.

stories.title: Months Ahead Of State Polls, Congress Names New Chiefs For Punjab, UP

en.title: Months Ahead Of State Polls, Congress Names New Chiefs For Punjab, UP
en.summary: The Congress party has appointed new leaders for the Punjab and Uttar Pradesh state organizations ahead of upcoming state elections.

en.title: Hockey Legend Pargat Singh Named Punjab Congress Chief After Raja Warring Quits
en.summary: Former hockey player Pargat Singh has been appointed as the new Punjab Congress chief following Raja Warring's resignation from the position.

en.title: 700 Detained As Delhi, Mumbai See Big Protests Against Gyanesh Kumar
en.summary: Large-scale protests occurred in Delhi and Mumbai, resulting in approximately 700 detentions, including AAP leader Atishi in the capital.

en.title: 'Charanjit Channi Saheb Has Won': Raja Warring Meets Rahul Gandhi After Exit As Punjab Congress Chief
en.summary: Raja Warring met with Congress leader Rahul Gandhi following his departure as Punjab Congress chief, amid internal party tensions over leadership.

stories.title: Rahul demands CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation as protests erupt in Delhi, Mumbai

en.title: Rahul demands CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation as protests erupt in Delhi, Mumbai
en.summary: Rahul Gandhi called for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation amid protests in Delhi and Mumbai over alleged irregularities in electoral-roll revision. Approximately 700 protesters were detained in Delhi during demonstrations.

en.title: 2027 polls: Congress names Pargat Singh as Punjab chief after Warring's exit
en.summary: The Congress party appointed Pargat Singh as Punjab chief following the departure of the previous leader ahead of the 2027 elections.

stories.title: Warring out, Pargat in: Has Congress solved Punjab crisis or set stage for another twist?

en.title: Warring out, Pargat in: Has Congress solved Punjab crisis or set stage for another twist?
en.summary: Amarinder Singh Raja Warring resigned as Punjab Congress president after four years amid internal leadership disputes involving multiple party figures. Questions remain whether the party has resolved its internal conflicts.

stories.title: Nasdaq rises 1%, Dow, S&P close higher as weak jobs data tempers rate hike bets

en.title: Nasdaq rises 1%, Dow, S&P close higher as weak jobs data tempers rate hike bets
en.summary: U.S. stock indices gained following a disappointing employment report that reduced expectations for future interest rate increases. Weak job creation and reassessments of Federal Reserve policy drove gains in real estate and small-cap stocks.

stories.title: Fed officials give hints on rate decision as markets cut October rate hike odds

en.title: Fed officials give hints on rate decision as markets cut October rate hike odds
en.summary: Federal Reserve officials signaled a cautious approach to rate decisions, prompting market participants to lower the probability of a rate increase in October. Inflation and upcoming economic data remain key factors for the Fed's policy path.

stories.title: Sleepless on Wall Street: All-night stock exchanges coming soon

en.title: Sleepless on Wall Street: All-night stock exchanges coming soon
en.summary: U.S. equity exchanges will introduce overnight trading sessions beginning December 6 to attract foreign investors and compete with cryptocurrency markets. Institutional investors remain concerned about liquidity and market risks during extended nighttime hours.

stories.title: Bets on US Federal Reserve rate hike in October fall as job market cools

en.title: Bets on US Federal Reserve rate hike in October fall as job market cools
en.summary: The U.S. labor market weakened significantly with job creation falling far short of expectations and unemployment rising to 4.2%. Market participants substantially reduced expectations for another Federal Reserve interest rate hike this year amid ongoing inflation concerns.

stories.title: Fed’s Jefferson urges patience on rates; Kashkari sees more hikes ahead

en.title: Fed's Jefferson urges patience on rates; Kashkari sees more hikes ahead
en.summary: Federal Reserve officials expressed different views on interest rates, with one seeing no immediate need for adjustments while another indicated potential future hikes. Both acknowledged ongoing inflation above the 2% target.
